editorial:
Ever wondered what it actually takes to make a hit comic book? You get to see that struggle here through Moritaka, a kid who is terrified of burnout but finds a reason to fight when he falls for a girl. The vibe is super inspiring and high-energy. You will love watching him team up with the smart and driven Akito to build their dream from the ground up. It is not just about drawing; it is about the friendship and the promise they make to their future spouses. The chemistry between the leads makes the whole journey feel real and exciting.

What really hits home is the pacing. It moves quickly and shows you the hard work and the failures without getting boring. The acting is great, though some of the drama feels a bit over the top at times. Still, it is a total win if you love underdog stories.
endingExplained: After years of hard work and many setbacks, you see Moritaka and Akito finally reach the top of the manga world. They achieve their goal of creating a massive hit series. The story wraps up with the emotional payoff you have been waiting for: Moritaka and Miho finally get married. It proves that their promise from school was real and that their hard work paid off in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories, art, or anime.
